title: Darkside of Xeen — surface world layout v1
status: Source-based terrain and travel study; no native ODMs generated

scale.note: The six equal squares depict adjoining travel areas. Each future ODM has a larger scenery apron; those aprons overlap conceptually and are not six extra strips of geography. Town footprints are authored independently.

regions.title: Alamar / Necropolis
regions.intent: Lava fields in the west, dry approaches around Necropolis and Griffin Pass, snow at the northeast edge. Shadowspire treatment is localized to the necromantic district; retain the surrounding source landforms.

regions.title: Desert / Northern Highlands
regions.intent: Snow and snowy forest in the north; Desert of Doom and Perishing Sands to the south. Preserve the long snow/desert frontier and the Great Pyramid approach.

regions.title: Blackfang / Lakeside
regions.intent: Snowy Blackfang and Magic Mountain, Snow River Rapids, Octopod Lake and its original island. Forest and desert fringes continue from neighboring regions.

regions.title: Castleview / Kalindra
regions.intent: Temperate inhabited south, Dark Grove, Acid Pond and winding watercourses; dry rocky northern fringe. The town and Kalindra need independent native-scale footprints. Recommended first region.

regions.title: Sprite Forest / Southern Tower
regions.intent: Desert fringe and Gemstone Range in the north, Sprite Forest and watercourses in the south. Bark and Southern Tower are separate landmarks. Preserve off-road caves and camps.

regions.title: Sandcaster / Eastern Forest
regions.intent: Sandcaster at the dry northern edge; Crossroads, Howling Woods and Aging Forest farther south. Continue the River of Wrath and keep Venom Pond distinct.

palettes.name: Grassland
palettes.note: Established temperate town palette and ordinary roadside vegetation.

palettes.name: Forest
palettes.note: Canopy and ground-cover composition supply the woodland identity; dark and light woods remain distinct.

palettes.name: Dirt / badlands
palettes.note: Dry shelves and exposed rocky ground, with deliberate quiet spaces.

palettes.name: Necromantic ground
palettes.note: Proposed local Necropolis art direction. Dead trees, ruins and architecture matter as much as the ground. No new tar lake is implied.

palettes.name: Desert / sand
palettes.donor: MM8 Ironsand; MM7 sand as a lighter option
palettes.note: Separate pale sand from volcanic ground; deserts do not automatically contain lava.

palettes.name: Volcanic land / lava
palettes.note: Preserve northwest lava channels. A new large volcano is not part of this layout; the source does not establish a crater here.

palettes.name: Snow / cold rock
palettes.note: Locally available snow and snow-to-dirt family; audit final transition-bank assignment before generating terrain.

palettes.name: Ridges / mountains
palettes.note: Relief in this study is illustrative and derives from source mountain classes; heights are not measured MM5 elevations.

palettes.name: Rivers / lakes
palettes.note: Keep shallow and deep source water, narrow river continuity and the Lost Souls island. Magical ponds need their own eventual material/effects choice.

firstRegion.reason: Tests town density, established temperate assets, water, countryside and two regional exits in the main starting hub.
firstRegion.firstBuildScope: Plan the complete SW travel square first; build Castleview and its Kalindra approach as the first reviewable district within it. Keep Ellinger/sewer entrances, Western Tower and both regional connections reserved.
firstRegion.deferred: Detailed interiors, full quest export, sky mechanics and final combat balance. These are future work, not removed content.
